# World flags

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/flags.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The named points with a heading that level scripts add with `AddFlag(name, {x, y, z}, heading,
activity, group)` and use to spawn humans, send them somewhere and test against
([World flags](../research/flags.md)). Scripts keep the handle `AddFlag` returns; `FindFlag` finds a
flag by name. Ambient humans pick flags by **activity**: a flag with one is a spot where a
civilian sits, smokes, warms his hands or leaves the level.

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every `AddFlag` call whose name is a literal string: 7,057 flags (4,167 names) added by 94 scripts
    of 62 levels. 23 positions are computed at run time and show none; 79 flags come from scripts shared by several
    levels or whose names are not recovered (*other*). What each activity does is on
    [World flags](../research/flags.md#activities); what the group means on path-network flags is not traced. The
    two flags `InitLevel` adds itself (`CrimeScene`, `GangCall`) are not listed.

7,057 entries. Data: `research/references/flags.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `<script>:<name>`, with `#2`, `#3` ... for a name the same script adds again. |
| `level` | str | | The level whose scripts add the flag; none for a shared script. |
| `name` | str | | The flag's name (`AddFlag`'s first argument; `FindFlag` matches the first 15 characters). |
| `pos` | list | | Position `{x, y, z}` in metres, game axes (z up), when the script gives it literally. |
| `heading` | float | | Facing in degrees about z. |
| `activity` | int | | Fourth argument (flag `+0xd0`): what a human does there; picks the clip and who may use the flag ([activities](../research/flags.md#activities)). 0, none, is left out. |
| `group` | int | | Fifth argument (flag `+0xd8`): a store's group number or a path network's bits ([groups](../research/flags.md#groups)). 0 is left out. |
| `script` | str | | The script that adds it (without `.lua`). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
